name: POVAL KOGYO Co., Ltd.
summary: POVAL KOGYO Co., Ltd. makes and markets specialized and synthetic resin belts in Japan, including conveyor belts made to order, functional belts, drive belts and urethane timing belts. It also supplies polishing pads, mounts and cushioning components for glass polishing, nonwoven fabrics and urethane foam products. The company dates from 1957 and has its head office in Nagoya, Japan.
